status: verified hot-path changes; remaining canvas limits explicitly retained

baseline.cacheBaseline: Immediately before changing font/path cache primitives; other optimizations already present.

environment.execution: macOS ARM64; owned profiles and ports; no own builds or other test suites during final timing runs
environment.timingQualification: Same-host observational timings, not dedicated-hardware lab measurements. No own builds or other suites during timed runs; brief artifact inspection occurred during the Electron sequence. Desktop drag timings vary substantially.

changes: Arc document snapshots with copy-on-write isolation; Prepared is borrowed; GPU ID lookup allocates only on insertion
Exact JSON byte counters and static-scene delta reuse; one document/patch parse per renderer use
Font/glyph caches use shared read locks and bounded second-chance eviction; exact keys and font lineage retained
Electron host workers own JSON encode/decode, bounded request queues and FPR1 binary replies; local Rust prepares geometry and CPU exports
Ordered async submission, cancellation fences, generation-safe saves, fatal-session retirement and explicit retry recovery
Mouse wheel exponent 0.002 to 0.003 on Web/Electron; native pinch unchanged
Fix minified alpha half-up rounding and WebGPU scalar-coverage uniform collision at slot 245; flag now uses slot 251

microbenchmarks.method: Median of per-round p50; see raw samples. CPU tests exclude fixture construction and hashing. No GPU FPS inference.

memory.scope: One whole native microbenchmark process per variant; not application live memory

web.conclusion: No broad page speedup established; cold view changes remain about 1.0-1.6 s; cached zoom about 65-93 ms.

limitations: Large full-math desktop cold rendering is still slow; high-zoom surface-budget failure remains in both baseline and optimized builds. No quality/budget relaxation was introduced.

smallvec, Cow and explicit SIMD were not introduced without matching benchmark evidence; dynamic dispatch/borrowed fields were not changed globally.

Windows/Linux packages, physical trackpad hardware, multi-monitor behavior and signed distribution were not validated.
One existing frontend test remains skipped; historical document sections were not exhaustively re-reviewed.
